source: Homebrew rules — optional campaign rules that override the standard Earthdawn 4E rulebooks. Authoring guide: docs/HOMEBREW-RULES.md. Each rule is pure data (inputs + plain-English notes); nothing here stores a derived value. A rule applies globally (every character) when `enabled` is true. A rule may `formula` (replace a rating with a term sum), `effects` (adjust values via the standard taxonomy, docs/EFFECT-TAXONOMY.md), and/or `set` (v2: override a registry target — karma.step / karma.maxCap / karma.ritualCost — with a scalar or a race-keyed map). Refs resolve against the character (engine/characteristics.js); the set-target registry lives in store.js (HOMEBREW_SET_TARGETS).
note: This file is loaded optionally (knacks/thread-items precedent): if it is absent the app behaves exactly as before. Rules ship `enabled: false` until the owner turns them on.

rules.name: Durability-scaled Health Ratings
rules.overrides: Players' Guide p.64 — Health Ratings (Unconsciousness & Death)
rules.summary: These rules are added to better reflect a true unconsciousness & death rating based on a characters base Toughness and how much they train their Durability

unconsciousness.note: Term1 + Term2 = (Durability Rank × Toughness Step) + table uncon

terms.note: Term2: The standard Unconsciousness base from the characteristics table.

death.note: Term1 + Term2 + Term3 (Durability Rank × Toughness Step) + Toughness Step + table death

terms.note: Term3: The standard Death base from the characteristics table.

rules.name: Race-driven Karma economy (ED-classic buy-back)
rules.overrides: Players' Guide p.83 — Karma Ritual (house rule)
rules.summary: The Karma Ritual is no longer a free refill: you buy Karma back with Legend at a race-driven cost, up to a race-driven maximum, and the Karma die is race-driven. This rule makes karma use rarer and increases its etherial position
rules.note: Uses the ed-homebrew/2 `set` lever (docs/HOMEBREW-RULES.md §5.5, plans/PLAN-HOMEBREW-KARMA.md). karma.maxCap is the racial ceiling (engine applies min(Modifier×Circle, cap)); karma.step is the Karma die Step (= the racial Modifier); karma.ritualCost is the Legend spent per Karma point on the paid ritual (a dated, undoable Legend sink). Ships disabled.
